12.overview: Siya is in a corner. Angie is afraid that accidents happen in threes, while Elzette doesn’t hold up her end of a deal.

12.overview: Tino wants to throw a party, while Willem plays a trump card that has consequences for Justin. Another inexplicable sign is found in the wetlands, and Gary discovers something that changes everything.

12.name: Episode 160
12.overview: Bianca makes a drastic decision, while Elzette pleads with Willem on Justin’s behalf. Nazeem suffers a big setback and Bridgette gives Riaan and Zoe a talking-to.

12.name: Episode 161
12.overview: Stella struggles to come to terms with her new reality, while a heartbroken Gary is desperately searching for Claire. Frankie comes up with an idea for Elzette to strengthen her case against Willem’s client.

12.name: Episode 162
12.overview: Gary sulks about his relationship, while Angie moves in with the Daniels family, bringing along a surprise. Elzette and her team get help from an unexpected source in their battle against Willem and his client.

12.name: Episode 163
12.overview: Bridgette wants to cash in on the craze around Ruiterbosch’s new visitors. Siya sees a glimmer of hope, while Tino thinks Wade is keeping Angie and Zoe on a line while weighing his options.

12.name: Episode 164
12.overview: The truth behind the strange sightings in the wetlands is revealed, while Tino and Wade compete with treats for the baby. Siya confronts Elzette.

12.name: Episode 165
12.overview: Angie and Tino clash, while Elzette struggles to navigate the aftermath of her doings. Lee-Ann warns Willem against Nazeem, and Zoe and Riaan are pushed into a corner.

12.name: Episode 166
12.overview: Mymoena spells out Bianca’s choices. Angie realises she has to establish better boundaries, while the strange visitors leave Ruiterbosch.

12.name: Episode 167
12.overview: Willem has to go for more tests, while Bianca receives a call about Stella. Angie and Wade get a surprise, and Zoe has to be brave.

12.name: Episode 168
12.overview: Bianca and Siya try to work on their marriage. Wade’s emotions are all over the place, while Gary gets big news from Namibia. Willem confesses something shocking...

12.name: Episode 169
12.overview: Mymoena feels she played a part in Bianca's sorrow, while Willem seeks a second opinion. Tino becomes increasingly concerned about Angie and Wade’s relationship.

12.name: Episode 170
12.overview: Willem makes a desperate decision, while Bianca feels that everyone is ganging up against her. Wade and Angie spend more and more time together, which makes Tino worry about her.

12.name: Episode 171
12.overview: Angie and Wade share an intimate moment about their baby. Willem presents Justin with a difficult choice and Bianca responds to Siya's ultimatum.

12.name: Episode 172
12.overview: Siya and Bianca share a moment, while Wade has a heart-to-heart with Mike. Justin’s fundraiser for Njammies Takeaways is a huge success, much to Nazeem’s irritation.

12.name: Episode 173
12.overview: Angie and Wade struggle to be honest with each other, while Siya and Bianca take the next step towards reconciliation. Tensions rise between Willem and Justin, and there seems to be no chance of reconciliation.

12.name: Episode 174
12.overview: Tino decides enough is enough. Mike encourages Justin to reach out to his father, while Stefan shows up in Ruiterbosch.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 153
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Claire shows Gary how remorseful she is about what she did and that she lied to him, while a strange object strikes Bennie on the head. Elzette and Mymoena come to blows…

nextEpisodeToAir.name: Episode 154
nextEpisodeToAir.overview: Gary is worried when Nazeem starts asking questions about Claire, while Frankie warns Riaan not to get more involved with Bennie and his wild imagination. Mymoena tries to hide Elzette’s blackmail from Siya, but will she be able to carry the secret on her own?

overview: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.
title: Suidooster
